resources.string: A previous Hootbook database is on this device. First, check a private copy with Core to see the actual import counts and unsupported data. Your original database is not changed by this preview. Normal use and sync stay paused until the upgrade is complete.
Working on your private copy. Please keep this screen open.
The counts below come from a real Core import into an isolated temporary database. Review each omitted category before choosing whether to continue.
This is a preview, not a completed migration. The final report will show the result returned by the actual import.

These source counts are separate from the Core report. The default-account count is a saved selection, not an account record. You can recreate templates and select a default account after upgrading. Missing files cannot be recovered by the importer.
Financial records are included in the omissions

The Core report includes skipped financial records or settings, including any already-deleted records shown above. Review the category counts carefully. Transaction history and related details may differ after the upgrade. Export a recovery package before continuing if you need an independent copy.
I have reviewed the counts and field changes, and accept that the omitted items will not transfer to the new ledger.
Old sync bindings, device identifiers and sync keys do not transfer. Set up sync again after upgrading; the old cloud sync data is not imported.

These counts describe whole records, not every field change. Core replaces stored balance history with balance anchors; earlier history can differ. Category mappings, duplicate names and currency codes may change. Unsupported transaction reference, recurring and billing-cycle fields and copied bank/account text do not transfer. Same-currency transfers use the sent amount. Some account details, budget account references and subscription recurrence settings are normalized or omitted. Original files remain available for recovery.
AI settings: could not be safely read. Original secure preferences are retained; set up AI again after upgrading.
AI settings: additional setup is required after upgrading. Any readable settings are prepared for import; a usable credential could not be confirmed.
AI settings: prepared for Core import.
AI settings: found in the source. Check the configuration after upgrading.
AI settings: none found in the source.
Brokerage settings: could not be safely read. Original secure preferences are retained; reconnect the brokerage service after upgrading. Source counts are unavailable.
Brokerage settings: readable source data is available for Core import.
Brokerage settings: none found in the source.

Prepared settings and source counts do not confirm acceptance by Core. Any reported unsupported connections appear in the Core omissions above. Check AI and brokerage settings after upgrading. Credentials are never displayed here.
The ledger import and platform settings are complete. The report below is the result of the actual Core import. Your original files are retained, including the items that were not transferred.

The import was interrupted before a verified result was saved. Some or all records may already be in Core. The preview below is not proof of what was committed. Do not repeat the import: an automatic replay could duplicate or conflict with data. Your original files and recovery information are retained. Export a recovery package and resolve the import status before continuing.

A successful Core import result has been saved. Some platform settings or files still need to be applied. Finish this step to continue. This action resumes platform work only and does not import the ledger again.
A verified migration could not be prepared. Your original files are retained. You can export a recovery package or try checking the source again.
The last operation could not be verified. Your original files are retained. Check available storage and use the recovery action offered on this screen.
The operation stopped unexpectedly. Reload the saved migration status before taking another migration action. No import will be automatically replayed.
The saved migration report is incomplete. Reload the migration status to verify the actual result before continuing. Do not repeat the import.
The document chooser could not be opened. No recovery destination was selected. Try exporting again with an available document provider.
Your originals stay on this device
The original database, WAL, attachments and secure preference files are retained. Completing the upgrade does not delete them.

A recovery package preserves the available original data and migration information. It is for recovery, not a directly importable Core backup. Keep this package private and choose a trusted destination.
Recovery package saved. The original files are still on this device. Exporting does not change the migration status.

This package contains private financial information and service settings, which may include credentials. Choose a trusted destination in the Android document chooser. Anyone with access to the package may be able to read its contents. This is a recovery package, not an importable Core backup.
Core status reports configuration and saved-key presence only. It does not verify that the AI service will accept the credential.
